title: Automatic shut off a problem
text: Automatic shut off a problem. This iron does an excellent job of ironing. It is easy to fill, empty and to clean.  However, the automatic shut off is very quick.  In the seconds it takes to put an ironed shirt on a hanger, it could shut off.  It does not automatically restart when you put the iron down to work on your next item - and, before you know it, the iron has cooled down so much that the water leaks out from the vents.  I've learned to check the display in the handle frequently - but what a pain!

features: Digital Temperature Control - The clear-view LCD screen makes it easy to customize fabric and steam settings. Plus, the screen will flash “READY” once the iron is preheated to the selected temperature
Stainless Steel Soleplate - The durable, heavy-duty soleplate glides smoothly over all fabric types to press out wrinkles in no time
Variable Temperature and Steam Controls - Independent steam and temperature controls give you the ability to customize each setting separately for the best results across all fabric types
